unitReview.decision: Publish the workbook numeric coordinates at authored metre scale; reject the historical unconditional /1000 conversion.
unitReview.rationale: The 0.8-1.841 coordinate magnitudes are metre-scale and align with the current metre-based public EXL-50U CAD; applying /1000 would collapse the ports by three orders of magnitude.
unitReview.authorityBoundary: This is a reviewed compatibility correction for the current public metre-based CAD, not surveyed, as-built, experimental or engineering-authoritative geometry.

formulaReview.s2Decision: Recompute every S2 X/Y pair from azimuth and the reviewed 1.841 m canonical radius; never publish cached formula results.
formulaReview.sideDecision: Publish D26 only after verifying its cache equals 0.9 m and matches the remaining S1 Z constants D27:D37.
